name: The Reports
summary: From Kharanos, Senir Whitebeard sends word to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge about the Frostmane threat to Dun Morogh. He asks you to leave his scout unnamed.

sections.title: A Dispatch to the Capital
sections.body: The report carries news from deep inside Frostmane Hold, where the trolls threaten Dun Morogh. Senir wants you to take it straight to Barin Redstone and keep the scout from the snowy crags unnamed.

sections.title: Friction in the High Seat
sections.body: Senator Barin Redstone grows angry when Senir’s report reaches Ironforge’s royal court. He resents Senir invoking King Magni’s authority to approve his operations. His anger reveals the Senate’s resentment of the King’s decrees and the field work carried out in his name.

faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven mountaineer stationed near Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He oversees scouting and military reconnaissance against Frostmane trolls encroaching on dwarven settlements.
Barin Redstone is a sour, aristocratic dwarf senator who lives in Ironforge’s throne room near King Magni Bronzebeard. Common petitioners annoy him easily.

faq.q: Why is Senator Redstone angry about the report?
faq.answer: Senir warns you that Senator Redstone is sour. You learn why the senator is angry when you deliver the report.

faq.q: Why does Senir Whitebeard ask to keep your help secret?
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard asks you to keep your help secret so his superiors will believe he completed the arduous scouting himself. He does not want to admit that an adventurer carried out the work.

aliases: where to turn in the reports
faq.answer: You deliver the report to Senator Barin Redstone in the High Seat of Ironforge, the great chamber where King Magni Bronzebeard holds court.

faq.q: What does this quest reveal about Ironforge politics?
faq.answer: Delivering the report introduces Ironforge’s Senate and the officials who receive frontier reports. Redstone’s response offers a glimpse of Ironforge politics.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see the balance between King Magni’s crown and the dwarven Senate’s parliamentary power when you deliver the dispatch in the High Seat.
As an Alliance member, you see Ironforge’s civic layout and the bureaucracy that shapes Alliance domestic policy.
